findings.text: non-blocking: the head gate log's own header line records rev 72236e1b58106536e694dc262e4e42778eba270c, which is the base revision, because the gate ran before b4624dc2 existed; the same header names the passing 24-test arm, so the receipt as stored labels the revision that fails 2 tests as the one that passed, and only the manifest's commit line ties the result to the landed head.

non-blocking: the added Answer class duplicates the fake urlopen response already owned by tests/agent/test_bench_provenance.py:85 (_FakeResponse: _body/status/read/__enter__/__exit__) and the suffix-routed dispatcher at tests/agent/test_bench_provenance.py:102 (_stub_urlopen); it copies rather than extends the owner, adding only a headers attribute, so promoting one shared response/fixture helper would stop the two drifting apart.

item_verdicts.call_sites: The landed change is confined to tests/test_agent_reload.py, so no production module can reach it; the production path it exercises was read instead (imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:2351 _serving_validator calling _completion_verdict at :2270 and _dialect_probe_failures at :2340, and imas_ambix/agent/bench.py:783 check_tool_call / :907 check_tool_use) and is unchanged by the commit.
item_verdicts.diff: Read commit b4624dc2 against base 72236e1b: one file, tests/test_agent_reload.py (63 insertions, 8 deletions), replacing the bare io.BytesIO urlopen stub with an Answer response object plus a route-dispatched completion stub; no assertion in the test was added, removed or relaxed.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names the exact pytest command and requires base and head logs; logs/base.txt and logs/head.txt both carry that command in their header and a bare EXIT line (EXIT=1 and EXIT=0), with 24 collected in both arms, but the head log's header names revision 72236e1b (the base) rather than the landed b4624dc2.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is that tests/test_agent_reload.py passes at main with both failing parametrisations of test_real_validation_closure_enforces_completion_threshold fixed at their cause; logs/base.txt records the two parametrisations failing with AttributeError at imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:2906 and logs/head.txt records 24 passed, with imas_ambix/agent/cli.py unchanged.
item_verdicts.manifest: The manifest records commit b4624dc2, changed path tests/test_agent_reload.py, both gate logs and the negative-control log, states the cause as a stale test rather than product code, and its claimed ruff result carries no log although a re-run of ruff check on the reviewed head passes.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The declared scope is tests/test_agent_reload.py and imas_ambix/agent/cli.py; git diff 72236e1b b4624dc2 changes only tests/test_agent_reload.py and leaves imas_ambix/agent/cli.py untouched.

justifications.durability: tests/test_agent_reload.py:457-466 keeps the 199/200 boundary assertions unchanged and they read production output, and both directions were falsified: reverting the stub reproduces logs/base.txt's 2 failures, and raising the threshold to 201 makes [200-reloaded] red with 'replacement completion validation failed' at logs/negative-control-200.txt:160.
justifications.evidence: logs/base.txt and logs/head.txt each carry the named command, 24 collected and a bare EXIT line (1 then 0), and the negative-control logs show the threshold refusal traceback, but the head log's header names the base revision and the ruff result in the manifest has no log.
justifications.fit: tests/test_agent_reload.py:385-410 follows the file's existing stub-in-test idiom, names nothing forbidden, and the commit b4624dc2 carries a conventional subject with a mechanism-level body.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/test_agent_reload.py:400-433 answers /v1/messages with a tool_use block and /v1/chat/completions carrying tools with a tool_calls message, which is what imas_ambix/agent/bench.py:783 and :907 require, so the two failing parametrisations now reach the completion threshold they assert.
justifications.reuse: the capability search over tests/ found the same fake urlopen response owned at tests/agent/test_bench_provenance.py:85 (_FakeResponse) and its routed dispatcher at :102, and the added Answer class at tests/test_agent_reload.py:385 duplicates them instead of extending them, with no shared conftest helper existing to extend.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 72236e1b b4624dc2 changes only tests/test_agent_reload.py, inside the two declared write paths, and every hunk is the stub rewrite or the import it made dead.
